name: slot-text
title: Slot text
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Text and numbers that spin into their next value on staggered reels, like a slot machine.

meta.descriptionEs: Texto y cifras que giran hasta el nuevo valor, un rodillo por carácter.

examples.title: Texto de rodillo
examples.description: Texto y cifras que giran hasta el nuevo valor, un rodillo por carácter.

api.name: value
api.description: What to show. Numbers are grouped for en-US unless format is set.

api.name: duration / stagger / spins
api.description: First reel length, delay between reels, and extra digit turns.

api.name: align
api.description: Which end keeps its identity when the length changes. Numbers default to end.

api.name: announce
api.description: Polite live region for the new value.

docs: Adapted from Arc UI (MIT). Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Motion is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion.
